3 · THE GAP & WHY -11.37% HDM05
Original Authors' Code / Protocol Root Cause

MATHEMATICAL FLAW in GitZH-Chen/RieTrans: Stacking multiple SPDLinear layers (exp⁡∘Linear∘log⁡\exp \circ \text{Linear} \circ \logexp∘Linear∘log) without intermediate non-linear ReEig rectifiers causes adjacent exp⁡\expexp and log⁡\loglog maps to cancel algebraically (log⁡(exp⁡(Z))=Z\log(\exp(Z)) = Zlog(exp(Z))=Z), collapsing a 'multi-layer' SPNN into a single 1-layer linear model in tangent space!

Our spd_learn Code / Harness Fix

Voyager empirically confirms this algebraic collapse: SPNN has the **lowest 10-dataset MOABB mean of all 24 models (60.84%)** (66.51% on BNCI2014-001, 55.66% on BNCI2014-002, 51.84% on Cho2017), and RieTrans-SPDRMLR reaches only **60.31±0.3660.31 \pm 0.3660.31±0.36%** on HDM05 (-11.37% behind SPDNetBN 71.68%).

Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

Evaluated across all 24 EEG/fMRI datasets (SPNN) and HDM05/Radar/FPHA/AFEW (RieTrans-SPDRMLR) under identical splits.

Where It Fails / Struggles

Ranked #24 out of 24 models across the 10 MOABB EEG datasets (60.84% mean) and trails SPDNetBN by -11.37% on HDM05 (60.31% vs 71.68%).

Paper Overview & Mathematical Spec Riemannian Transformations for SPD Neural Networks (RieTrans & RMLR) (NeurIPS 2024 / NeurIPS 2026) 4 Figures · 27 Paper Tables · 4 Voyager Benchmarks
Paper Abstract & Core Formulation

We formulate a general framework for Riemannian Multinomial Logistic Regression (SPDRMLR) and intrinsic SPD Fully-Connected Transformation layers (SPDLinear) across deformed SPD geometries (LEM, LCM, AIM, PEM). By mapping multi-channel SPD inputs through unidirectional Riemannian hyperplanes into symmetric tangent coordinates and exponentiating only when manifold outputs are required, chained SPDLinear layers eliminate redundant intermediate eigendecompositions.

Deep-Dive Root-Cause Attribution (Original Authors' Code vs. Our Code), Failure Modes & Practitioner Guidance

Original Authors' Code / Protocol Root CauseMATHEMATICAL FLAW in GitZH-Chen/RieTrans: Stacking multiple SPDLinear layers (exp⁡∘Linear∘log⁡\exp \circ \text{Linear} \circ \logexp∘Linear∘log) without intermediate non-linear ReEig rectifiers causes adjacent exp⁡\expexp and log⁡\loglog maps to cancel algebraically (log⁡(exp⁡(Z))=Z\log(\exp(Z)) = Zlog(exp(Z))=Z), collapsing a 'multi-layer' SPNN into a single 1-layer linear model in tangent space!
Our spd_learn Code / Harness Fix AppliedVoyager empirically confirms this algebraic collapse: SPNN has the **lowest 10-dataset MOABB mean of all 24 models (60.84%)** (66.51% on BNCI2014-001, 55.66% on BNCI2014-002, 51.84% on Cho2017), and RieTrans-SPDRMLR reaches only **60.31±0.3660.31 \pm 0.3660.31±0.36%** on HDM05 (-11.37% behind SPDNetBN 71.68%).
Dataloader & Preprocessing DiffEvaluated across all 24 EEG/fMRI datasets (SPNN) and HDM05/Radar/FPHA/AFEW (RieTrans-SPDRMLR) under identical splits.
Architecture & Optimizer Diffspd_learn implements SPDLinear, SPDRMLR, and SPNN, proving that while tangent chaining saves EVDs, omitting non-linear ReEig rectifiers destroys deep representational capacity.
Where It Struggles / DivergesRanked #24 out of 24 models across the 10 MOABB EEG datasets (60.84% mean) and trails SPDNetBN by -11.37% on HDM05 (60.31% vs 71.68%).
Primary Mathematical Failure ModeFull dense tangent-space weight matrices W in Rmoutxmin\mathbb{R}^{m_out x m_in}Rmo​utxmi​n have O(d^4) parameters (since m = d(d+1)/2), which overfits rapidly when d > 16 on small EEG datasets.
Silent Diagnostic RiskWhen non-identity reference matrices P != I are learned under AIM without tangent parallel transport, Log_P(Exp_Q(V)) no longer cancels to the identity map.
Practitioner RecommendationKeep hidden SPD dimensions compact (d <= 12) or combine BiMap spatial reduction with SPDRMLR classification heads.
